explanations.label: Context-dependent effect
explanations.statement: The effect depends on SYN-CONTEXT-B subtype or SYN-TARGET-A allotype context rather than being a general consequence of SYN-TARGET-A modulation.

explanations.label: Indirect pathway
explanations.statement: SYN-TARGET-A is perturbed, but the SYN-CONTEXT-B-related phenotype arises through an indirect pathway rather than proximal catalytic modulation.

explanations.label: Off-target activity
explanations.statement: The phenotype arises primarily from compound activity at targets other than SYN-TARGET-A (for example ERAP2 or unrelated proteins).

explanations.label: On-target SYN-TARGET-A modulation
explanations.statement: The SYN-CONTEXT-B-related cellular phenotype produced by the compounds arises from direct modulation of SYN-TARGET-A in those cells.
